title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-dk3c.5: sched_work_handler releases lock before send_announce — phantom announce possible after stop
description:
sched_work_handler (announce.c:684-699) checks sched.running under the mutex (line 688-691), then releases the lock before calling send_announce() (line 697). A concurrent lichen_announce_sched_stop() could set running=false and cancel the work in the gap. Since send_announce() already passed the running check, it would transmit a phantom announce after the scheduler was stopped.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/announce.c:684-699
Severity: P2
